## Submission checklist

- [ ] One project folder, its optional supporting files, and one showcase index row; no unrelated changes.
- [ ] `showcase.md` begins with a working demo video or clickable video preview before its title.
- [ ] Placeholders are replaced; page rendering, video access, and relative links are checked.
- [ ] Creator credits, project status, and Skills used are accurate; concept footage is identified.
- [ ] I have permission to share the included files; applicable licenses and attribution are recorded.
- [ ] The submitted demo/preview may be displayed with creator credit in the repository and featured READMEs.
- [ ] No secrets, private material, large video/build files, dependency folders, or unrelated project exports are committed.
- [ ] Relevant content warnings are included.
